sources.extractedText: What's the difference between CFM displaced and free air delivery? CFM displaced is the amount of air the pump draws in and compresses. Free air delivery is what actually reaches your equipment. The displaced number is always larger, and some manufacturers lead with it in their specs because it looks more impressive on paper. The number you want is free air delivery. That's what you'll actually have access to on the job. If a spec sheet only shows displaced CFM, ask for the delivered number before you commit to anything.
